title: Kuwait reports injuries and damage to power and water plants after Iranian attack

snapshot.title: Kuwait reports injuries and damage to power and water plants after Iranian attack
snapshot.description: KUWAIT CITY: Kuwait Petroleum Corporation on Saturday said one of its oil facilities was hit by “repeated Iranian attacks” amid an escalation in hostilities between the US and Iran and the subsequent spillover across the Middle East.
